info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Operational Actions Management API
info.description: The Operational Actions Management API streamlines the process of executing critical operational tasks within IT management systems. This API allows authorized users to initiate various operational actions, enhancing efficiency and response times in a banking environment. Typical consumers include IT administrators and operations teams who require a method to manage and execute tasks programmatically. By centralizing operational actions, organizations can improve oversight and maintain effective control over their IT systems.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new operational action within the IT management systems. It processes the submitted data and triggers the necessary workflows to implement the action effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send operational action requests in the IT Management Systems Operations context. It encapsulates the necessary data required for managing and executing operations within IT systems.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method, where a valid JSON Web Token (JWT) must be included in the request's Authorization header. The token should be generated through a secure authentication process and it grants access to the API resources provided that it is valid.
